subject.title: [Bug]: Bootstrap files in agentDir are silently ignored — only workspace directory files are injected into system prompt

question: Should OpenClaw keep bootstrap prompt files workspace-owned and warn on bootstrap-named files in agentDir, or should an explicitly configured agentDir also become a trusted bootstrap prompt source?
rationale: Current code and docs make workspace the bootstrap source, while the user impact is a silent safety-rule failure; changing agentDir into prompt authority is a security-sensitive product boundary that automation should not choose.

options.title: Land warning-only diagnostic
options.body: Preserve workspace as the prompt bootstrap source, warn on misplaced agentDir bootstrap files, and document the correction path.

options.title: Adopt explicit agentDir loading
options.body: Allow explicitly configured agentDir files to supply or override bootstrap prompt context after defining precedence, diagnostics, docs, and security proof.

options.title: Pause for design
options.body: Keep the issue and linked PRs open until maintainers decide the permanent prompt-source boundary.

recommendation.title: Land warning-only diagnostic
recommendation.body: Preserve workspace as the prompt bootstrap source, warn on misplaced agentDir bootstrap files, and document the correction path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on central bootstrap resolution and workspace/bootstrap docs among the likely owners.
